Riddle answers hide festival traditions and meanings.|[[Yangyang]]}} '''Riddle Twiddle''' is an event-exclusive [[Point of Interest|point of interest]] located in [[Taoyuan Vale]], [[Central Plains]], [[Huanglong]] during the [[By Moon's Grace]] event. Players can visit every day during the event for prizes. ==NPCs== * [[Xieyang]] ==Descriptions== {{Description|Riddles offer a perfect mix of entertainment and mental challenge. Cracking them provides a satisfaction that goes beyond tangible rewards
{{Color|#a5a19d|Build or Upgrade this stall to gain more Popularity. Visit the stall to experience the mini-games for daily rewards.}}|[[Map]] description}} Riddle Twiddle Location.png|Location ==Dialogue== {{Dialogue Start}} ;(First interaction) :'''Xieyang:''' A full moon hangs in the midnight sky... :'''Xieyang:''' Waves crash and echo, cliffs stand high... :{{DIcon}} Excuse me, is this for the lantern riddles? :'''Xieyang:''' You're in the right place! See these lanterns? They are all set for the game! :'''Xieyang:''' The Moon-Chasing Festival fuels my brilliance! It ignites my creativity, setting the stage for my next masterpiece! :'''Xieyang:''' Don't worry about running out of riddles.
